I left test files out of the ranking and included subfolders. The next largest file, `outbox.ts` at 409 lines, just missed the cut.

A "matching test" here means a file with the same name ending in `.test.ts`. Tests for two of the untested files may live under other names:
- **`migrations/workspace.ts`:** `replica-schema.test.ts` could test it.
- **`index.ts`:** `boot.test.ts` could test it.

I didn't open those files to check. `link.ts` has no test file with a name that looks related.
